test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight friends Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Laxmi and Rani are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Mansi is third to the left of Monika. Aarti is second to the right of Monika. Shweta is fourth to the left of Payal. Payal is second to the left of Mansi. Rani is third to the right of Kajal. Kajal is not the immediate neighbour of Mansi. Who is second to the right of Kajal?
solution:
As per the given information:

1. Mansi is third to the left of Monika.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/156cebdd7dc891d51d007a4244a983149c2143ff1fd2b8c4d65647ce046330f7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4bae189f7a4fbf5e0351c5b7e5a3951f78d4b32edcd066d43069fba93f77411.png] 

2. Aarti is second to the right of Monika.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/662947b7b51064e84de3737805141e46c5b16b2960eac08dc515607cdd8679d4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bcbad9165e733ca3d37c11ead70bd630bf785b7f88c251087d177cff16b1df9.png] 

3. Payal is second to the left of Mansi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3b24ec558a29f25ad9d7e4abbc42e861375ed01786acb095924d7cb35c62a12.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2735fb1bfb2b2955bfd53c3e9c046edff45b501d46f01c788328bb8b842e2c6.png] 

4. Shweta is fourth to the left of Payal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e81228f26455c0928c83c195dd8c7d3985798a48c84f3de4af0ffd1d871777b5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b317db7c874385e44fcc2ed8932e0b080ebee19717a823361d348cdc233270eb.png] 

5. Kajal is not the immediate neighbour of Mansi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d22dc97e22a247636a7d9f7039142e1e4975548852375b739c956166f357d5bd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e5382eece03854a4e42a43105bc2c4f55b68403597eb936217419763c729183.png] 

6. Rani is third to the right of Kajal and the remaining position is for Laxmi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd1ab0a7972b94324bb20d28ed30ce907b1095d60b53005207ae4ce8515408ec.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e7bca3903285c7bc2a98e642406042be91bef62a6b722194edd6319f15b1f70.png] 

Here, **Payal **is second to the right of Kajal.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
